findings.body:
chunk 1/13:

Calling `plans/roadmap.json` archived here does not retire it from v1. For example, `FORGE-LED-0` remains pending at `plans/roadmap.json:810` and references the deleted `factory-event-export.md` spec. V1 still directs users to this roadmap (`src/forge/nextstep.py:97–100`), and `story new` accepts its keys (`src/forge/story.py:95`). Consequently, obsolete work remains available through the normal workflow despite the switch's requirement to supersede old pending stories. Retire those entries in the roadmap consumed by v1, preserving their history in the archive.
findings.title: Supersede the old pending stories in the live roadmap
